Quick reminder: please submit your panel scorecards for Elena Park by EOD Wednesday (Oct 21). We have a short window to finalize the hire/no-hire recommendation before the recruiting team needs to trigger the next interview loop.

Checklist: 
- Fill out the attached panel-scorecard.xlsx (rows: technical, design, collaboration, hire_risk)
- Add 1–2 bullet justifications for any score that's a 2+ point deviation from the median
- If you disagree on weightings, flag it in the sheet and add a short note here

I'll consolidate and run a quick normalization across the panel on Thursday morning. If anyone is going to miss the deadline, please flag here so I can reassign follow-up.

Thanks Priyom — use the pilot rubric (35/35/20/10). We decided to weight system design a little higher for senior infra hires because of the role-specific needs. I'll normalize using z-score across the panel, then scale back to the 0–10 range.

Normalization rules I'll apply (quick summary):
- Compute mean and stddev per category across submitted scores
- Convert to z-scores, cap at +/-2 to limit outlier influence
- Rescale to 0–10 and compute weighted sum using pilot weights

Please do add concrete evidence for any +/-2 deviations (e.g., "missed horizontal scaling tradeoffs during design; no mention of caching strategy"). That just makes the post-normalization discussion much faster.

If anyone can't meet EOD Wednesday, ping me here and I will follow up with a reminder and offer a 24h extension only if necessary.

—Marissa

All done — scores submitted and I left short justifications where my numbers diverge. A couple of quick takeaways before you normalize:

- I gave a 6/10 on system design because Elena's approach showed good tradeoffs but didn't surface latency tail concerns under heavy load. I noted the exact step she skipped in the justification column.
- Ben's collaboration callout is fair; I nudged his rationale with an example from the cross-functional exercise.
- Priyom — when you normalize, please flag any case where the capped z-score hits -2 or +2; those are candidates for a quick sync rather than blind rescaling.

I've dropped a short consolidation doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Aqz-example-score-justifications — feel free to add line items if you want me to include them in the recap to recruiting.
